headline.purpose: App-level identifiers only. The 'clippr' wordmark in the header. One per screen.

title.purpose: Card and section headings: Speakers, Settings, Output.

body.purpose: Input values, file names, primary descriptive text.

label.purpose: Button text, interactive element labels, speaker row names.

caption.purpose: Metadata, stats, secondary sub-text: file duration, frame counts.

micro.purpose: Field labels above inputs, format tags, footer hints.

mono.purpose: Log stream only. Never in UI labels or stat values.

shadows.name: accent-glow-rest
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA (Generate button) at rest. The only ambient shadow in the system.

shadows.name: accent-glow-active
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA during active processing (pulse-glow animation peak).

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: Default button on hover. Conveys physical press response.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (color, background, border).

motion.name: ease-lift
motion.purpose: Button translateY lift on hover. Short duration (0.15s).

motion.name: pulse-glow
motion.purpose: Generate button during active processing. Oscillates Accent Glow shadow opacity.

components.name: Button Default
components.description: Secondary and toggle actions. Frosted semi-transparent surface on dark backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: rgba(232,232,232,0.9); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.13); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(108,99,255,0.7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn { transition: background 0.12s ease; transform: none !important; } }

components.name: Button Primary
components.description: Primary action (Generate). Iris Violet fill. One per screen.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polygon points="5 3 19 12 5 21 5 3"/></svg> Generate clips</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #ffffff; background: #6c63ff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 22px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(108,99,255,0.35); transition: background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8078ff; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(108,99,255,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(108,99,255,0.8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; box-shadow: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition: background 0.15s ease; transform: none !important; } }

components.name: Button Icon
components.description: Compact icon-only or icon+label actions in dense rows.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Download"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.12s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(108,99,255,0.7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-icon:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary container for all panels (Speakers, Settings, Progress, Output). No shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1e1e1e; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { padding: 14px 18px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #e8e8e8; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px 18px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text and number inputs. Input Well background with Iris focus border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: #888888; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-field-input { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #e8e8e8; background: #2a2a2a; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; outline: none; width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: #6c63ff; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #6c63ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(108,99,255,0.3); }

components.name: Toggle Group
components.description: Pill-style segmented control for mutually exclusive options (clip count, framing mode).
components.css: .ds-toggle-group { display: flex; background: #2a2a2a; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-toggle-btn { flex: 1; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #888888; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-toggle-btn:hover { color: #e8e8e8; } .ds-toggle-active { background: #6c63ff; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Thin fill bar showing job progress. Three semantic states: running, done, error.
components.css: .ds-progress { height: 6px; background: #27272a; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-bar { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; transition: width 500ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-progress-running { background: linear-gradient(to right, #7c3aed, #3b82f6); animation: ds-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-progress-done { background: #10b981; } .ds-progress-error { background: #ef4444; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.65; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-progress-running { animation: none; } .ds-progress-bar { transition: none; } }

components.name: Log Stream
components.description: Terminal-style machine output. Geist Mono, Terminal Void background. Signature component.

components.css: .ds-log { height: 160px; overflow-y: auto; border-radius: 10px; background: #09090b; border: 1px solid #27272a; padding: 12px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'Fira Code', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-log-line { display: block; } .ds-log-num { color: #52525b; user-select: none; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-log-cursor { color: #6c63ff; } .ds-log-blink { animation: ds-blink 1s step-end infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } } .ds-log-error { color: #ef4444; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-log-blink { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
clippr is a professional instrument, not a consumer app. The visual system takes its cue from the controlled, deliberate environments where precision work gets done: the film darkroom, the mixing booth, the machine room. Everything runs in low ambient light. The interface is quiet so the content — the video, the speakers, the output clips — is always the loudest thing on the screen.

The palette descends from near-black through tonal charcoals, using depth to separate function rather than color. One accent — Iris Violet — marks where the machine is active. It appears infrequently, which makes it informative. The type scale is tight and deliberate; fonts are system-tuned sans-serifs that carry precision without calling attention to themselves.

This system explicitly rejects the warm-neutral SaaS aesthetic, the cluttered panel-maximalism of professional video editors, and the performative vocabulary of AI marketing tools.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black foundation with tonal charcoal layers — no warm tint, no blue shift
Single violet accent used exclusively for active states and primary actions
Restrained type scale: system sans at calibrated weights, mono for terminal output
Shadows are state-driven, not structural — surfaces are flat at rest
Motion is brief and functional: feedback and transitions, no choreography
Density is a feature — tight spacing carries authority, not cramped-ness

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Iris Violet (#6c63ff) is the only non-status color used for interactive signal. It does not appear on decorative elements, headings, or icons at rest. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Depth-As-Structure Rule
rules.body: The five neutral tiers map directly to elevation: Darkroom Black (body) → Panel Charcoal (cards) → Input Well (inputs/toggles) → Terminal Void (log stream). Never reverse this order.

rules.name: The Mono Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only in the log stream and machine output surfaces. Not for code snippets in copy, not for numeric stat values, not for IDs.

rules.name: The Weight-Is-Role Rule
rules.body: 400 = content. 500 = interactive. 600–700 = headings. Do not use bold weight on body text for emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels, and containers have no box-shadow at their default state. Shadows appear only in response to state: hover, selection, or active processing.

dos: Do use Iris Violet (#6c63ff) exclusively for interactive signal: focus rings, checked states, active selections, running process indicators.
Do maintain the tonal depth stack: Darkroom Black (body) → Panel Charcoal (cards) → Input Well (inputs).
Do keep Dim Ink (#888) as the floor for all secondary text on dark surfaces.
Do use Geist Mono exclusively for machine output. All UI text uses Geist Sans.
Do show progress concretely: stage name, percentage, and the live log stream.
Do pair every status color with a text label or icon — never rely on color alone.
Do apply focus-visible outlines (2px Iris Violet offset-2) to every interactive element.
Do use @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) alternatives for all animations.
donts: Don't use warm-neutral backgrounds. No cream, sand, beige, paper, linen, or near-whites with warm tint.
Don't introduce a second accent color. The legacy blue CTA (#2563eb) is deprecated — migrate to Iris.
Don't build Adobe/Premiere-style interfaces: no persistent multi-panel layouts, no sprawling toolbars.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient).
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) as a card or callout accent.
Don't put shadows on resting panels or cards.
Don't use uppercase tracked text on more than 2–3 elements per screen.
Don't display 'Nothing here' as an empty state — show what to do next.
